input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

risks.mitigation: Run once and publish actual output and counts. If PostgreSQL is unavailable, report that known issue and do not infer results.
risks.description: observation/tests/target-schema.test.ts:7-8 requires OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL; database-backed tests may fail before exercising T2.

risks.mitigation: Detach first, verify db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, and use it for citations and head_sha.
risks.description: The worktree starts at a8856584, while the audit ref is db2a5d49; pre-checkout evidence could cite later code.

risks.mitigation: Use those supporting paths and publisher tests when assessing the focus files.
risks.description: Ordered delivery also traverses observation.ts and read-store.ts, beyond T1's two focus files.

body.summary: No blocker or ambiguity. Target db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef has the same tree as PR #791 squash a27e026e. T1 and T2 are present with focused tests, the audit workflow is implementable unchanged, and PostgreSQL availability is the only material qualification.

findings.description: The target ref resolves to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef and its tree equals a27e026e, the squash commit labeled #791; branch, PR artifact, and content are consistent.

T1 is supported: grading_enabled is named and absent means false while non-booleans are rejected (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-10,21-41); mapping emits the committed config or null (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-49). Tests cover parsing and exact replay delivery (oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83; oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-208).

T2 fencing is exact: status, owner, attempt, and unexpired lease are checked after locking and again on update (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-228). Expired, reclaimed, old-attempt, and lock-wait cases are tested (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357).

T2 completion, attempt update, and observation insert share one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-292), and the worker propagates the exact claim (observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95). A refused append rolls back both completion and answer (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244).

The test script exists (observation/package.json:6-8), but observation/tests/target-schema.test.ts:7-8 requires OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL. The specification correctly requires actual output and treats inability to run as a known issue.

requirements.description: Exactly one audit cohort with exactly tasks T1 and T2.
Audit default-off grading_enabled and ordered launch delivery.
Audit exact-claim fencing and atomic completion plus observation append.
Builder detaches at target, makes no forbidden mutation, tests once, reports actual evidence, and publishes existing PR #791.
Assessor checks the same SHA, gives a finding per task, cites path:start-end and separate test/output evidence.
Keep artifacts short and add no operator choice.
